title: Superposition Without Interference? Towards Isolated Interventions via Almost Orthogonal Features in Language Models
abstract: arXiv:2602.04718v5 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: A central premise in mechanistic interpretability is that meaningful concepts in language models are represented by linear features in activation space. For such features to support reliable interventions, manipulating one feature should not substantially alter the effects of others. In practice, however, feature entanglement leads to interference such that localized interventions can have unintended downstream effects. Motivated by the _Independent Causal Mechanisms_ principle, we propose to constrain internal features to be almost orthogonal. We argue that this promotes modular representations amenable to causal intervention. We formalize this problem by characterizing the gap between an idealized isolated intervention and its realized effect on model outputs in terms of feature interference. translated_title: 无干涉的叠加？通过语言模型中的近似正交特征实现隔离干预
translated_abstract: arXiv:2602.04718v5 公告类型：交叉替换 摘要：机械可解释性的一个核心前提是，语言模型中的有意义概念由激活空间中的线性特征表示。为了使这些特征支持可靠的干预，操纵一个特征不应显著改变其他特征的效果。然而，在实践中，特征纠缠会导致干涉，使得局部干预可能产生意想不到的下游影响。受独立因果机制原则的启发，我们提出将内部特征约束为近似正交。我们认为这促进了模块化表示，便于因果干预。我们通过特征干涉来形式化描述理想化隔离干预与其对模型输出实际效果之间的差距。我们以特征字典的自相干性来上界特征干涉的传播，并将此与离散性联系起来。
tldr: 本文提出通过约束语言模型内部特征近似正交，以减少干预时的特征干涉，从而实现更可靠的隔离干预，并理论证明了干涉传播的上界与特征字典自相干性的关系。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes constraining internal features in language models to be almost orthogonal to reduce feature interference during interventions, enabling more reliable isolated interventions, and theoretically bounds interference propagation via feature dictionary self-coherence.
